# Get all downloaded songs by paginating through all pages
access_token = login_result['access_token']
downloaded_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    downloaded_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total downloaded songs:", len(downloaded_songs))
print("Downloaded song IDs:", [song['song_id'] for song in downloaded_songs])

# Set of downloaded song IDs
downloaded_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in downloaded_songs}

# Get current song
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current)

# Loop until we find a downloaded song
max_iterations = len(queue) + 1  # safety
for _ in range(max_iterations):
    if current['song_id'] in downloaded_ids:
        print("Found downloaded song:", current)
        break
    # Go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song result:", next_result)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("New current song:", current)
else:
    print("No downloaded song found in queue")
